en-US.author: Brad Moore
en-US.description: DLSS Swapper swap DLSS dlls in games.
en-US.longDescription: DLSS Swapper is a tool that allows you to conveniently download, manage, and swap DLSS dlls allowing you to upgrade or downgrade DLSS version in a game without the game needing an update.
en-US.name: DLSS Swapper
en-US.releaseNotes:
Feature Highlight

Bulk DLL swap
You can now bulk swap DLLs and presets to many games at once thanks to the new bulk swap feature. Find bulk swap in the toolbar on the games page. Thanks to RafaelHGOliveira for adding this functionality.

Improved performance and reliability
A bug that would cause games library to stop being loaded has been fixed. An additional benefit is that a full library scan is now completed faster. Thanks to Swissola for discovering this issue and implementing a fix.

What's Changed
- Added batch DLL swap: select multiple games and apply in one pass (by @RafaelHGOliveira in #913)
- Fix Steam scan crash from updating UI-bound properties off the UI thread (by @Swissola in #933)
- Added DLSS FG preset C (by @beeradmoore in #961)
- Fixed update prompt never showing for a newer version (by @ethanstoner in #932)
- Added update banner (by @hammadk306 in #966)
- Added SECURITY.md (by @beeradmoore in #954)

Translation related update
- Add Hebrew (he-IL) translation (by @dnullptr in #950)
- Update the Simplified Chinese translation. (by @juij-fun in #964)

New Contributors
- @hammadk306 made their first contribution in #966
- @Swissola made their first contribution in #933
- @ethanstoner made their first contribution in #932
- @dnullptr made their first contribution in #950
- @RafaelHGOliveira made their first contribution in #913
